d: Long, flowing ash-grey hair with straight bangs and a slightly messy texture is topped with a white and black peaked cap. The eyes are a sharp, glowing orange-red with a confident, intense expression on a youthful face. A slender build is dressed in a white military-style coat with gold trim on the cuffs, worn over a dark grey pleated skirt, a red waist sash, and black leather belts. This ensemble is accompanied by black gloves and large, grey mechanical naval rigging featuring cannons and armored plating attached to the back.
